title: Potian, Corcuera lead A.V. Silo past Travis to book PYBC Growee Cup semis berth
summary: A.V. Silo x LBDL Under-13 outlasted Travis x DBall, 78-74, in the quarterfinals of the Philippine Youth Basketball Championship (PYBC) Growee Cup over the weekend at Unilab High Court in Mandaluyong.
